title: Building Data Genome 2 — raw hourly water meters
attribution: Miller et al. and Building Data Genome 2 contributors (2020)
locationNote: Anonymized Panther education buildings at a US reference site. These are not London campus measurements.
notes: Original local timestamps contain no UTC offset; daily totals follow the dataset's 24-row local-day convention.
Raw readings are retained, without interpolation, winsorization, or hidden zero removal.
Whole-building water is not automatically eligible non-potable demand.
Clipped data and derived benchmark artifacts retain upstream Attribution-ShareAlike terms separately from application code.
